override.reason: The handoff explicitly required mirroring advance()'s existing pattern (same _check_condition helper, same EngineError refusal shape) rather than inventing a new mechanism. Extracting a shared _raise_unmet-style helper now, for exactly two call sites (advance, record) where record's version is narrower (command-kind only, gated on result=='pass'), would be exactly the premature generalization the standard warns against. A genuine third occurrence would tip this to a real, flag-worthy duplication worth extracting.
